subject: Renewable Energy Milestones & A New PaperCo Perk Just for You!
html_email:
Hi there,

Exciting to see how renewables are rapidly gaining ground—this year alone, solar and wind are expected to provide nearly a fifth of global electricity, and U.S. offshore wind projects are back on track after recent legal wins.

In the spirit of innovation, PaperCo is now offering a premium subscription with 10% off all your paper orders. It’s perfect for forward-thinkers who appreciate both sustainability and savings!

Hope all is well—let us know if you’d like more regular updates on renewables or want to chat about the new offer!

Best,
The PaperCo Team
